initiatives.name: SBTi Science-Based Emissions Targets
initiatives.summary: The company has set SBTi-validated targets to reduce absolute Scope 1&2 emissions by 50% and Scope 3 emissions by 30% by 2030 from FY22 baseline. They have already surpassed the operational emissions target and will review it in 2026.

evidence.title: Science-Based Emissions Reduction Targets

evidence.quote: Reduce our absolute Scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions 50% by 2030, from a FY22 base year (SBTi validated as 1.5°C-aligned).
